description: This line plot illustrates the accuracy of next token prediction for two distinct experiments, labeled Ex1 Accuracy and Ex2 Accuracy, as a function of training step. The x-axis, labeled "Step", is linear and spans from 0 to 60000, with tick marks at intervals of 10000. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)", is also linear and ranges from 0.10 to 0.40, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The blue line, representing Ex1 Accuracy, begins at approximately 0.235 at step 0, rises sharply to about 0.395 by step 10000, and then plateaus near 0.40 from step 20000 to step 60000. The cyan line, representing Ex2 Accuracy, starts at 0.095 at step 0, increases steadily to approximately 0.285 by step 10000, then continues rising to about 0.38 by step 20000, and finally stabilizes near 0.385 from step 30000 to step 60000.
